limits: This is a scoped developer heuristic score, not a novice participant study, global product quality score or promise of functional perfection.
No VoiceOver session, older macOS hardware matrix, real Intel hardware run, sustained rendering/frame-pacing benchmark or real system Reduce Motion toggle was performed by this reviewer.

The helper uses current production AppKit view classes and neutral disabled fixtures. Some guide footer route closures are safe fixture stubs; full-guide/add-files navigation is not an end-to-end claim from this helper.
Actual final installed signed application launch, system service registration and conversion smoke checks belong to root's release/install verification.
Native semantic-colour contrast ratios were resolved separately; they do not measure all rendered glass backdrops or certify every secondary label.
